problems: The wake runs the wrong way. The bow (mast foot, star 79375, about x=370 y=313) is on the right and the stern (star 82369, about x=152 y=331) is on the left, so the boat sails right. Its wake should trail left, behind the stern. Instead, stars 78727 (about 412,345) and 78207 (about 447,413) trail down and to the right, ahead of the bow.
The lantern (star 79593, about 355,165) is correctly at the top, so the figure is the right way up.

The sail reads well as a triangle: the luff runs from the masthead lantern to the mast foot, the head corner is star 79882 (about 333,189), the belly is star 80628 (about 278,274), and the foot runs along the hull to the waist, star 81377 (about 225,326).

The hull is a faint blue curve under a nearly straight gold line from stern to bow. Its bottom sags to about y=365, so it reads as a hull, but the gold trace is flat and the curve is only weakly drawn.
Labels collide: 'the waist of the hull, where' overprints 'the stern of the boat', and several labels are clipped at the right edge ('the far end of the wake, tra').
The wave line under the hull (about y=375-383) is a separate stroke that is not connected to the hull, so the water reads as a stray mark.
output.advice: Keep the sail and hull as they are. Fix the wake: move star 78727 to a point behind the stern, roughly x=120-140 near y=340-350, and star 78207 further left and down, roughly x=90-110 near y=390-410, so the wake trails from the stern toward the lower left, away from the direction of travel. Move the stern label (star 82369) so it does not overlap the waist label, and shorten or wrap the long labels so they stay inside the frame. Optionally deepen the hull curve so its belly sits near y=365-370 and join the waves to the hull bottom.
